requirements.text: Complete the generation-to-ParaView-to-visual-acceptance pipeline for seven 3D Lagrangian families.
requirements.audit_rule: Require producer-linked native, typed, XMF/XML, render and visual metadata for every counted product; reports and previews alone are insufficient.

requirements.text: Every case has a real 3D mechanism, a full primary-event time domain, traceable particle identity/state, required geometry and motion/rigid state, a directly openable dynamic file, event previews, and parameter/input provenance.
requirements.audit_rule: Check source indexes for N3/time/UID/state/geometry/motion or rigid joins, XMF/XML references, preview references, and provenance joins. Treat this as metadata evidence, not a numerical or physical certification.

requirements.text: Exclude obvious bad initial states, severe wall crossing, explosion, nonfinite state, unexplained large particle loss, and early termination.
requirements.audit_rule: Keep producer omission/loss metadata and early-termination status visible. Unknown loss cause is a disclosed limitation and cannot be rewritten as zero loss.

requirements.text: Use independent physical cases in 8/24/48 batches, with 8 and 24 actual subsets of the final 48 and no resolution replica, rerun, time-slice, or derived-view duplicate.
requirements.audit_rule: Validate each family list for exact lengths, uniqueness, and subset relations, then check the seven final rosters for cross-family duplicate physical IDs.

requirements.text: Stage 1 is labelled visual check passed, numerical precision not accepted; Q-N and Q-E are not granted.
requirements.audit_rule: The audit must preserve precision-status labels, Q-N/Q-E false state, and Stage 2 precision/transport/event-label/external-validation gaps.

requirements.text: Cumulative limits remain 512 GPU hours, 3840 CPU core hours, 1024 qualification attempts, 720 production attempts, Home >=500 GiB, and the original deadline.
requirements.audit_rule: Record the checkpoint resource snapshot without resetting or changing it.

stage2_gaps_explicit: spatial convergence and integration/save-frequency error budgets
Q-N numerical reference and Q-E external validation
